sources.name: Used Advantech AIM8I listings
sources.observation: Multiple AIM8I units are publicly listed around NT$2,000-2,500.
sources.limitations: Apparent listings are not qualified lot inventory and condition/yield are unmeasured.

sources.name: Advantech AIM8I manual
sources.observation: AIM8I uses Intel Atom x5-Z8350, 2GB LPDDR3, Windows 10 IoT Enterprise, 8-inch 1920x1200 400-nit touch display, micro HDMI, 16-pin USB3 dock and 14-pin USB2/UART/power extension connector; manual reports IP65 compliance.
sources.limitations: Installed options and physical condition vary by donor.

sources.name: ClockworkPi uConsole CM4 Lite
sources.observation: Official current kit price; demonstrates a market for compact keyboard-equipped Linux terminals.
sources.limitations: Different product, new kit, no industrial/rugged or FieldIO equivalence.

sources.name: ClockworkPi DevTerm A04/A06
sources.observation: Portable terminal kits occupy roughly the US$265-345 band, though current models are often out of stock.
sources.limitations: Different product category and supply situation.

sources.name: Used GPD Pocket 3 N6000
sources.observation: A used Pocket 3 listing at NT$12,000 is sold out.
sources.limitations: One listing; significantly faster general-purpose computer but without PF-003's proposed protected field I/O/rugged donor positioning.

sources.name: GPD MicroPC 2
sources.observation: Taiwan marketplace lists the current MicroPC 2 around NT$24,900.
sources.limitations: New current-generation machine with much higher compute performance.

boundary: The compact-terminal market demonstrates willingness to pay for specialized portable computers, but no source validates demand for FieldDeck itself or its NT$12,900 target.
